guitar.modelsText: Gibson SG Special / Rickenbacker / Fender Stratocaster / Gibson J-200
guitar.evidence: Pete Townshend's Gibson SG Special (smashed on stage, used on Live at Leeds) and earlier Rickenbackers are extremely well documented; deserves high rather than medium confidence given how iconic his windmill/SG combo is.
guitar.notes: Upgraded confidence from medium to high.

tone.target: jangly bright British pop-rock crunch with slight fuzz edge
tone.profile: jangly bright British pop-rock crunch with slight fuzz edge
tone.summary: A clean-boosted signal chain utilizing a Green OD for initial grit, followed by the UK 45 amp model to capture the bright, punchy Plexi sound. A Chorus adds necessary jangle, while the US Vintage 2x12 cab keeps the tone focused and bright.

rig.name: The Who - I Can See For Miles - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain tight riff definition.
Provide the initial subtle grit and punchy crunch required for the 60s sound without heavy distortion.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is chosen over Blues OD/OD 9 to better emulate a slightly dirtier, less scooped Plexi edge. This provides the 'fuzz edge' subtly.

blocks.purpose: Add the necessary 'jangle' and width characteristic of Rickenbacker-style pop-rock tones.
Introduce the required subtle fuzz/grit layer without overwhelming the clean attack or adding metal gain.
blocks.gap: The Red Haze is used sparingly (low drive) to provide a vintage, slightly woolly grit that complements the Green OD's punchiness.

blocks.purpose: Emulate the bright, punchy Plexi/Marshall sound required for classic British pop-rock.
Keep the overall tone focused, bright, and articulate, matching the small-to-mid cab clue.
blocks.gap: While UK Vintage 4x12 is an option, US 2x12 better maintains the 'chime' and brightness needed for this specific genre/era.

blocks.purpose: Boost the high end and clarity (chime) while slightly reducing low-end muddiness.
Add a subtle, dry room ambience to ground the tone without sounding washy or modern.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to enhance the vintage British pop-rock chime and clarity.

proposals.reason: Enhance bright, articulate 'chime' needed for Rickenbacker-style pop.
